headline: Appointed Charles Scalesse as Interim Assistant Principal and approved a Business Manager finalist
summary: The board met to interview candidates and discuss appointments for the Interim Lyman Hall High School Assistant Principal and Business Manager positions. The board unanimously appointed Charles Scalesse as Interim Assistant Principal for Lyman Hall High School. The board also approved appointment of a finalist candidate to the Business Manager position, 5 affirmative votes with 1 abstention.
decisions: Approved going into Executive Session for interviews and discussion of candidates for Interim Lyman Hall High School Assistant Principal and Business Manager Position.
Appointed Charles Scalesse as Interim Assistant Principal at Lyman Hall High School for 2026-2027, contingent on certification, unanimously.
Approved appointment of the finalist candidate to the Business Manager position for 2026-2027, 5 affirmative votes, 1 abstention.

decision_evidence.quote: Unanimous Approval to go into Executive Session pursuant to Connecticut General Statutes, Section 1-200 (6)(a) for the purpose of Interviews and Discussion of Candidates for Interim Lyman Hall High School Assistant Principal and Discussion of Candidates for Business Manager Position

Motion Passed - Unanimous Approve that the Board of Education Appoint Charles Scalesse to Lyman Hall High School - Interim Assistant Principal for the 2026 - 2027 School Year Contingent Upon Proper Connecticut Certification as Recommended by the Superintendent of Schools.
Affirmative - DOERR, REED, REGAN, ROSCOE VOTTO Opposed - NONE Abstained - DOERING Motion Passed - 5 Affirmative Votes 1 Abstained
